name: TESSERA Genomics GeneClinic Worker Full Rig
description: Teal bioseal scrubs with gene-compatible hip and tail-channel vents sewn into the back panel, worn under a transparent sterile overgown with color-coded hemline indicators for contamination zones. A close-fitting respirator hood with a clear face panel seals at the collar and filters aerosol and genetic particulate. Double-layered geneware-safe gloves — inner bioskin, outer polymer — allow tactile sensitivity during cell-handling. Sealed slip-on boots in antimicrobial white rubber complete the ensemble, and a hip-slung specimen tray holds labeled culture plates and a gene-reader wand.
functionality: Respirator hood filters genetic particulate to 0.1 micron; gene-compatible hip and tail vents allow unobstructed movement for workers with geneware modifications.
what_it_says: This person handles the raw material of identity every shift, and the protocol is the only thing standing between a therapeutic and a catastrophe.
story_hooks: The specimen tray holds a culture plate with no patient ID — just a handwritten symbol that matches a Shelf-based gene-cult's sigil.
The respirator hood's filter log shows it processed an unregistered aerosol compound during last Tuesday's shift, and no incident report was filed.
